raw_segments.text: Portia, if you had known the virtue of the ring, or half her worthiness that gave the
ring, or your own honor to contain the ring, you would not then have parted with the ring.
What man is there so much unreasonable, if you had pleased to have defended it with any
terms of zeal, wanted the modesty to urge the thing held as a ceremony?
Nerissa teaches me what to believe. I'll die for it, but some woman had the ring.
